meta.name: Top-Down Shooter / Shmup Template
meta.based_on: R-Type / Gradius / Touhou / Vampire Survivors conventions
meta.description: Animation requirements for a top-down or side-scrolling shooter character/ship. Covers movement, weapons, death, and power-up states.
meta.notes: Shmup sprites are typically smaller (32x32 to 64x64). The ship/character often stays centered with the world scrolling. Movement animations show tilt/bank rather than walk cycles.

weapons.label: Weapons / Shooting
weapons.description: Firing animations, charge attacks, special weapons

transformations.label: Transformations
transformations.description: Power-up forms, weapon upgrades, mode changes

states.name: idle_center
states.label: Idle / Centered
states.description: Default position. Ship/character hovering in place. Engine glow, subtle bob.
states.generation_prompt: idle hover animation, character/ship centered, engine glow pulsing, subtle vertical bob, 4 frames
common_issues: too much movement (should be minimal bob)

states.name: move_left
states.label: Bank Left
states.description: Tilting/banking to the left. Character leans left, maybe trail effect.
states.generation_prompt: banking left animation, character tilting left, slight lean, movement trail, 3 frames

states.name: move_right
states.label: Bank Right
states.description: Tilting/banking to the right. Mirror of bank left.
states.generation_prompt: banking right animation, character tilting right, slight lean, movement trail, 3 frames
common_issues: not a mirror of bank left

states.name: move_up
states.label: Thrust Up
states.description: Moving upward. Engine thrust stronger, maybe exhaust trail below.
states.generation_prompt: thrusting upward animation, character moving up, strong engine exhaust below, 3 frames
common_issues: no visible thrust difference from idle

states.name: move_down
states.label: Brake / Descend
states.description: Moving downward or braking. Engine flare forward, air brake panels.
states.generation_prompt: braking descending animation, character moving down, air brakes flaring, forward thrust, 3 frames

states.name: shoot
states.label: Primary Fire
states.description: Firing main weapon. Muzzle flash, weapon recoil. Fast loop since it fires continuously.
states.generation_prompt: shooting animation, muzzle flash from weapon, slight recoil, rapid fire, 3 frames
common_issues: muzzle flash too large for sprite size

states.name: shoot_special
states.label: Special Weapon
states.description: Powerful special attack. Bigger flash, charge-up, maybe character glows.
states.generation_prompt: special weapon animation, charge up then massive fire, character glowing with energy, big muzzle flash, 5 frames

states.name: projectile
states.label: Projectile / Bullet
states.description: Main weapon projectile. Animated glow/trail. Separate from the character.
states.generation_prompt: animated projectile, energy bolt with trailing glow, 4 frames cycling, bright colors
common_issues: hard to see against dark backgrounds

states.name: hit
states.label: Hit Reaction
states.description: Taking damage. Flash white/red, slight knockback.
states.generation_prompt: hit reaction, character flashing white then red, slight knockback shake, 3 frames

states.name: death
states.label: Death Explosion
states.description: Character destroyed. Multi-stage explosion: small pops → big boom → debris scatter → fade.
states.generation_prompt: death explosion animation, small initial pops then large explosion expanding outward, debris scattering, 8 frames

states.name: respawn
states.label: Respawn / Invincible
states.description: Spawning back in. Character fades in with sparkle/shield effect. Flickers to indicate invincibility.
states.generation_prompt: respawn animation, character fading in with sparkle shield effect, flickering, 4 frames

states.name: powerup
states.label: Power-Up Get
states.description: Collecting a power-up. Character glows, expands, transforms briefly.
states.generation_prompt: power-up collection animation, character glowing with energy aura, brief transformation flash, expanding outward, 5 frames
